algorithm: Rectified Flow (continuous action velocity-field prediction) + Masked Motion Token Prediction (discrete cross-entropy channel) inside a Mixture-of-Transformers / Mixture-of-Flow (MoF) action expert with shared 'Foundation Expert' layers and routed Top-K specialized experts
hand: Inspire Hand (Franka FR3); LinkerBot O6 (Unitree G1); unnamed 6-DoF dexterous hands on PND Adam-U and BeingBeyond D1; parallel gripper on LeRobot SO-101 (not dexterous)
arm: PND Adam-U (31-DoF humanoid, bimanual+head+waist); Franka FR3; Unitree G1; BeingBeyond D1 (single-arm); LeRobot SO-101 (single-arm)
success_criterion: binary success/failure per real-robot trial under a 'blind evaluation protocol' via a black-box inference server; LIBERO/RoboCasa use per-task mean success rate
headline_metric: LIBERO/RoboCasa average success rate; real-robot success rate by task category (Fig. 10)
headline_value: LIBERO 98.9% average (specialist), 97.6% (generalist), vs. best prior baseline EO1 98.2%; RoboCasa 53.9% total average (specialist), 53.3% (generalist), vs. best RGB-only baseline π0.5 at 41.4%; real robots: Being-H0.5-specialist best on most categories, generalist only marginally behind, both outperform π0.5 especially on long-horizon and bimanual tasks
human_data: UniHand-2.0: over 400 million samples from 35,000 hours of multimodal data (16,000 hours / 134M samples human egocentric video, MANO parameters estimated via HaWoR), totaling over 120B training tokens
paper_code_mismatch: Released code (commit e12ac44f) exposes only benchmark/inference/config scaffolding (policy.py, beingh_policy.py, dataset-transform configs) — no MoT/MoF model definition, no rectified-flow action-expert source, and no config for any dexterous-hand embodiment; the only post-train configs present (libero_robocasa.yaml, libero_all.yaml, robocasa_human.yaml, so101_example.yaml) are all gripper-only, so the dexterous-hand claims cannot be cross-checked against released code.
note_gaps: Ablation Table 8 numbers for removing masked motion-token prediction contradict the prose claim about the direction of the effect (flagged as an unresolved extraction error or paper-internal contradiction); no total/active parameter count is given for the full MoT+MoF action expert (only the 2B LIBERO/RoboCasa backbone is stated); per-embodiment real-robot success rates are read off a bar chart (Fig. 10) with no exact numeric table.
backbone: InternVL-3.5 (a 2B backbone explicitly used for the LIBERO/RoboCasa experiments; general parameter count not stated)
params: 2B (LIBERO/RoboCasa backbone); total/active parameter count of the full Mixture-of-Transformers + Mixture-of-Flow action expert not stated
action_head: Mixture-of-Flow (MoF) action expert combining a continuous Rectified-Flow velocity-field head (linear-interpolation probability path, MSE flow-matching loss) with a discrete Masked Motion Token Prediction head (cross-entropy over a pretrained quantized motion tokenizer), integrated via Mixture-of-Transformers with shared Foundation-Expert layers and routed Top-K specialized experts; deployment uses Euler-integration denoising with fewer than 10 steps
pretrain_data: UniHand-2.0: 35,000 hours / 400M+ samples / 120B+ training tokens, comprising 16,000 hours / 134M samples of human egocentric video (MANO annotated via HaWoR), 14,000 hours / ~1.5B frames of robot data across 30 embodiments, and 5,000 'equivalent hours' of vision-text data
dexterous_evidence: "real-robot evaluation uses a Franka FR3 arm fitted with the 'Inspire Hand,' a Unitree G1 fitted with 'LinkerBot O6,' a PND Adam-U with an integrated dexterous hand, and a BeingBeyond D1 arm with a dexterous hand, all tagged 'Dexterous (6DoF)'" (Table 2, sec. 7.1.1), distinct from the parallel-gripper LeRobot SO-101 also in the same real-robot suite.
